A custom data_as_elements list names the elements to convert

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { ConversionOptions, convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown";
function main() {
  const options: ConversionOptions = { dataAsElements: ["section"] };
  const result = convert("<div><section data-as=\"p\">First</section><section data-as=\"p\">Second</section></div>", options);
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
